architecture.signal_convention: single-ended internal tuning; differential CML output; high-Z loop filter node
architecture.reference_impedance: 50 Ohm at XO reference input; loop filter node ~MOhm

loop_parameters.note: Hybrid VCO: coarse cap-bank (~500 MHz/V open-loop), fine analog control (80 MHz/V, closed-loop). Only fine Kvco enters loop noise model.

blocks.name: PFD
blocks.topology_class: CMOS tri-state D-FF pair + reset AND
blocks.notes: Standard tri-state PFD. Dead-zone < 10 ps requires careful reset AND delay sizing. Fully digital at 0.7 V ASAP7 FinFET.

blocks.name: ChargePump
blocks.notes: Icp=1 mA selected to keep CP noise below -113 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz. Large Icp at VDD=0.7 V requires regulated mirror for output compliance. UP/DN mismatch <= 1% critical for reference spur. Shot noise floor: 17.9 pA/rtHz.

blocks.name: LoopFilter
blocks.notes: DOMINANT AREA BLOCK (6997 um2). C1=1.56 pF needs 3120 um2 MOM cap at 0.5 fF/um2. R1=35.7 kOhm in poly. 3rd-order: C3 provides spur suppression pole at ~6x f_ref. MIM cap (2-4 fF/um2) would reduce area 4x if available in ASAP7.

blocks.name: RingVCO
blocks.topology_class: 5-stage current-starved differential ring, cap-bank coarse + analog fine
blocks.notes: Leeson model predicts -114.7 dBc/Hz free-running at 1 MHz with 2 mW (F=2, 5-stage). Loop suppresses by 20 dB inside 10 MHz BW -> contribution at PLL output = -134.7 dBc/Hz (well within allocation). Cap-bank coarse tuning (digital, ~4-6 bits) sets coarse freq; analog control closes the loop. 1.4 GHz max at SS corner requires careful design. ASAP7 min inverter delay ~30 ps -> 5-stage ring feasible to 3.3 GHz max.

blocks.name: FeedbackDiv
blocks.topology_class: CML first stage + CMOS /13 counter (2/3 prescaler)
blocks.notes: CML first divide-by-2 at 1.4 GHz (input), then CMOS static divider for remaining count. Divider added PN at output = -140 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz; referred to PLL output = -140+22.3 = -117.7 dBc/Hz (well within budget). TSPC or CML first FF for 1.4 GHz operation at 0.7 V.

blocks.name: PostDiv
blocks.topology_class: T-FF power-of-2 divider (/1,/2,/4) + CML output buffer
blocks.notes: T-FF chain for /2 and /4; bypass for /1. CML output buffer drives 50 Ohm. Dividing improves PN: /2 -> -6 dB improvement for 641 MHz output. Digital; straightforward at ASAP7 7nm.

blocks.name: Bias_Ref
blocks.topology_class: DeltaVt-based sub-1V BGR + PTAT current mirrors
blocks.notes: Sub-1V BGR for 0.7 V supply using delta-Vt technique (different Vt devices via geometry or implant). PSRR >= 50 dB at 10 MHz is the critical spec to prevent VDD ripple coupling into VCO. Startup circuit required. 0.10 mW is tight; use minimal bias current and shared reference.

history.reason: Analog devshell added to librelane flake.nix; ngspice-45 and xschem-3.4.7 confirmed in nixpkgs; seed design_state.json written for pll_clkgen M-a.

All required budget targets present. Chain classified as PLL/clock with phase-noise/jitter as dominant budget. VDD=0.7V ASAP7 confirmed. XO->jitter self-consistency check: PN=-90 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz is consistent with 5 ps RMS when properly integrated over loop-shaped PSD.

Budget closes after two corrective iterations: (1) initial Kvco=500 MHz/V Icp=100 uA failed PN gate by 5.3 dB; (2) identified divider noise model error (no N^2 penalty for CML div floor); (3) selected Icp=1 mA Kvco_fine=80 MHz/V (cap-bank coarse). Final: PN=-112.1 dBc/Hz (22 dB margin), jitter=3.70 ps, power=4.50 mW (10% reserve), area=9547 um2 (52% reserve).

7 blocks partitioned: PFD, ChargePump, LoopFilter, RingVCO, FeedbackDiv, PostDiv, Bias_Ref. All supply-feasible at 0.7 V (no cascode required; 2*(Vdsat+Vt)+margin=0.70 V = VDD). Per-block spec table complete. Key architecture decision: hybrid VCO tuning (cap-bank coarse + 80 MHz/V analog fine).

Leeson model: ring VCO free-running PN=-114.7 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz with 2 mW (F=2). Loop suppresses by 20 dB inside 10 MHz BW -> VCO contribution -134.7 dBc/Hz at output. CP dominates jitter (3.67 ps). All blocks feasible. Four medium-risk warnings recorded (CP headroom, VCO cap-bank, LF area, BGR startup). No hard-infeasible block.

All 10 sign-off gates PASS. PN=-112.1 dBc/Hz (22 dB margin), jitter=3.70 ps (1.30 ps margin), power=4.50 mW (10% reserve), area=9547 um2 (52% reserve), PM=58.1 deg, lock=0.064 us. Architecture signed off; per-block spec contract ready for circuit-design.
PLL model plan: frequency-error control loop in ngspice (no OpenVAF/OSDI; B-sources + passive LF); SV-RNM for M-c co-sim. Specs traced: f_out=1.300GHz (integer-N), lock<20us, Kvco=80MHz/V, Icp=1mA.

Authored pll_behavioral.sp (ngspice B-source CP + 3rd-order RC LF + freq-error feedback) and pll_rnm.sv (SV-RNM with phase accumulator output clock, first-order vtune lock model). Two loop-backs: (1) phase-accumulator PD diverged -> switched to freq-error control loop; (2) CP polarity reversed.

ngspice -b pll_behavioral.sp: 0 errors, 5011 data rows, converges. Verilator --cc codegen: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 7 .cpp files generated. No OSDI (OpenVAF not in nix shell); ngspice B-source model is the analog behavioral reference.
